Overview.Name: Rajani Reddy
Overview.Goal: Improve appearance, energy levels, and overall health with a sustainable routine.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Egg curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-veg limited and mostly for dinner as preferred.
For sweet cravings, start meals with protein and eat slowly.
Late nights and boredom can trigger overeating; keep dinner timing fixed.
Use minimal oil and prefer pan fried or pressure cooked foods.
Small rice portions help with consistency and long-term adherence.
Focus on energy, confidence, and daily routine rather than only weight.
